Extracts full Open Graph metadata from a page

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine(null);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->ogTitle);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->ogType);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->ogImage);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->ogDescription);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->title);
```
